title: Fake 'Rojgar Sahayata' Scheme Message Debunked by Ministry

content.raw_text: A viral WhatsApp forward claiming a new government portal offers Rs 50,000 in unemployment support has been debunked by officials. The Ministry of Labour confirmed no such scheme or portal exists, and urged citizens to avoid clicking links shared in the forwarded message, which redirects to a phishing page requesting bank account details.

title: Ministry of Labour and Employment Denies 'Rojgar Sahayata' Scheme

content.raw_text: The Ministry of Labour and Employment clarifies that it has not launched any scheme titled 'Rojgar Sahayata Portal' and has not authorized any cash disbursement of Rs 50,000 to unemployed citizens. The public is advised to rely only on the Ministry's official website for information regarding employment support programmes. Legal action is being pursued against the operators of the fraudulent portal.
